cover.title: Your Bank Can Earn 55x Your Rate
cover.label: CHECKING

lines.text: Your bank can earn 55 times what your checking pays you.
lines.say: Your bank can earn fifty-five times what your checking pays you.

lines.text: It's the quiet engine behind America's biggest bank.
lines.say: It's the quiet engine behind America's biggest bank.

lines.text: As of September 2026, checking averages 0.07%. The Fed pays banks 3.9% to park cash overnight.
lines.say: As of September twenty twenty-six, checking averages zero point zero seven percent. The Fed pays banks three point nine percent to park cash overnight.

lines.text: On $5,000 for a year, you get $3.50. At the Fed, the bank could get $195, before its costs.
lines.say: On five thousand dollars for a year, you get three dollars and fifty cents. At the Fed, the bank could get a hundred ninety-five, before its costs.

lines.text: Or they can lend it out instead, and since 2020 there's no reserve requirement.
lines.say: Or they can lend it out instead, and since twenty twenty there's no reserve requirement.

lines.text: At the end of 2025, JPMorgan held $620.4 billion in deposits paying zero interest.
lines.say: At the end of twenty twenty-five, JPMorgan held six hundred twenty point four billion in deposits paying zero interest.

lines.text: Its net interest income hit $95.4 billion in 2025.
lines.say: Its net interest income hit ninety-five point four billion dollars in twenty twenty-five.
The biggest jump was up thirty-four percent in twenty twenty-three.

lines.text: To a bank, your checking account is one of the cheapest loans it can get.
lines.say: To a bank, your checking account is one of the cheapest loans it can get.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Your bank can earn 55x what your checking pays you
post.ig:
Your bank can earn 55 times what your checking account pays you.
As of September 2026, interest checking pays 0.07% on average (FDIC). Since September 17, 2026, the Fed pays banks 3.9% on reserves.
On $5,000 for a year: $3.50 to you, up to $195 for the bank at the Fed, before its costs.
JPMorgan held $620.4 billion in no-interest deposits at the end of 2025, and its net interest income reached $95.4 billion in 2025.
Sources: FDIC national rates, Federal Reserve, JPMorgan Chase 2025 10-K.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
